department: PhD in Statistics and Computational Social Science (Steinhardt School)

deadline.value: The page gives a Fall start of December 1 with no year, so it is not used.

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test applies to this PhD; the page's GRE line is general.

supervisor.value: No supervisor rule is stated on the application page.

funding.value: The page links to PhD funding packages without stating a rule.

entry_route.value: The fetched application page does not say whether a bachelor's or master's is required.

app_fee.value: The Steinhardt application fee is $75, paid by major credit card only.
app_fee.quote: You will be prompted to pay a $75 application fee, payable by major credit card only.

gre_general.value: Steinhardt's GRE line for this PhD says not required.

toefl_min.value: Steinhardt's TOEFL iBT target is 100 on the original scale, or 5 on the new scale.
toefl_min.quote: Successful candidates score a 100 (original TOEFL iBT scoring) or 5 (new TOEFL iBT scoring starting January 21, 2026).

ielts_min.value: Steinhardt's IELTS target is an overall band of 7.
ielts_min.quote: Successful candidates achieve a band score of 7.

english_waiver.value: Only native English speakers or applicants with four years of US study skip the test, so an Indian applicant must submit TOEFL or IELTS.
english_waiver.quote: You do not have to submit an English language exam score if: | Your native language is English | You completed four years of study in the US

also.quote: Applicants holding or completing a graduate degree from an English-speaking institution are still required to submit official exam scores if their graduate education was fewer than four years in duration.

notes: Steinhardt is a separate school with its own application, so its fee and English rules are overrides. Field mapped to statistics by its title; the program is in a social-science school.
